toolsPreview.name: get_vault_stats
toolsPreview.description: Current on-chain metrics for SukukFi vaults on Berachain: capital held, pending deposits and redemptions, and participant counts. Refreshed from Berachain RPC.

toolsPreview.name: search_docs
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across public SukukFi writing: the documentation (how vaults work, obligor credit assessment, Islamic finance structuring, redemptions, risk, transparency) and the blog (explainers such as "is DeFi halal", "are stablecoins halal").

toolsPreview.name: get_doc
toolsPreview.description: Return a full SukukFi documentation page as markdown. Call search_docs first to find a slug, or pass a known slug such as "for-capital-providers/risk-considerations".

toolsPreview.name: get_contracts
toolsPreview.description: Verified SukukFi contract addresses on Berachain Mainnet with explorer links: the duPRT share token and the vault proxies for each accepted asset.

toolsPreview.name: get_vault_terms
toolsPreview.description: Deposit terms for the live SukukFi vault: target yield, capacity, minimum ticket, lockup, accepted assets and settlement cycle.
